Naples Global Advisors Llc who had been investing in Digital Realty Trust Reit for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $21.59 billion market cap company. Burt Wealth Advisors decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 21.32% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC.
